I do actually think this is mislabeled. It may be a 1gb drive but it's not from 1981. I worked at a data center in 83 and I remember when we received our first 1gb drives. They were dual spindle, in that they had two stacks of disks, the disk stacks were about 20 inches high. The enclosure this all was in was the size of two washing machines. And yes this was the latest and greatest thing available from CDC at the time. So what is pictured I believe is from a much later date.

I think it's probably about right. It looks like the disk pack from an IBM 3380 DASD. If I remember, there were two packs per unit and it was a little over 2gb per cabinet. (Plus, you needed the 3880 at the top of the chain.)
